## Scope

- Version:
- Roadmap item:
- User-visible change:

## Evidence

- [ ] The diff is limited to one version scope.
- [ ] Rust formatting, tests, and Clippy pass, or are not applicable with a reason below.
- [ ] `npm test` passes its report build, TypeScript typecheck, Node tests, and browser smoke, or is not applicable with a reason below.
- [ ] Privacy/redaction boundaries were checked.
- [ ] Required performance and compatibility gates pass.
- [ ] README, ROADMAP, and architecture documents are consistent with the implementation.
- [ ] Role-separated independent review is complete and blocking findings are resolved.
- [ ] Prohibited external backend/vendor references were not introduced.

## Evidence Details

Link commands, logs, manifests, or review comments for each applicable gate. For
release PRs, include every version-specific exit requirement from the roadmap and
`docs/reviews/vX.Y.Z.md`, including contract, subprocess, privacy/network, browser,
compatibility, and performance checks when declared.

- Test and static analysis:
- Privacy/redaction and network scan:
- Performance and compatibility:
- Version-specific evidence manifest:
- N/A checks and reason:

## Remaining Gates

List every incomplete check. Keep a release PR in draft until this section is empty.

## Review Findings

Record the human or subagent role, reviewed commit SHA, verdict, findings, and how
each blocking item was resolved. Re-review the affected scope after later changes.

## Merge Cleanup

- [ ] The version is marked `Released` only after all exit evidence is complete and the PR is mergeable.
- [ ] The resulting commit on `main` is verified after merge.
- [ ] Switch to updated `main`, then delete the merged branch locally and remotely unless this PR records a reason to preserve it.
